topic.title: The no-cost EMI phone trap: a phone EMI that never ends, against the same money invested

cta: Ever bought a phone on EMI? Comment
title: The no-cost EMI trap 📱
description:
What could a no-cost phone EMI have been instead?
A ₹4,000 phone EMI that never ends, against the same money put to work for 10 years at an assumed return. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
